name: warren-client-retry-policy
description: V0 campaign-controller Warren client (extensions/campaign-controller/src/warren-client.ts): dispatch POSTs never retry — ambiguous outcomes (network loss after send, 5xx) fail closed as dispatch_uncertain because warren's idempotency store is not restart-durable. Only safe GETs honor Retry-After with bounded retries. POST /runs returns 201 {run, sandbox}; GET /runs/:id returns 200 {run}.
